_about: Public-domain Louis de Blois (Blosius, 1506-1566, Benedictine abbot of Liessies) in English for the Word Hoard: A Mirror for Monks (1872), The Oratory of the Faithful Soul tr. Robert Aston Coffin (1848) and the Spiritual Works ed. John Edward Bowden (1903) from CCEL, Bertrand Wilberforce's Book of Spiritual Instruction (1900), Comfort for the Faint-hearted (1908) and Spiritual Mirror (1926), and the 1676 Mirrour for Monkes from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

blosius-mirror-for-monks: A Mirror for Monks, second edition, ed. John Duke Coleridge (London: C. J. Stewart, 1872)
blosius-oratory-faithful-soul: The Oratory of the Faithful Soul, tr. Robert Aston Coffin (London: Richardson and Son, 1848)
blosius-spiritual-works: Spiritual Works of Louis of Blois, Abbot of Liesse, ed. John Edward Bowden, fourth edition (London: R. & T. Washbourne, 1903)

blosius-spiritual-instruction: A Book of Spiritual Instruction, tr. Bertrand A. Wilberforce (St Louis: B. Herder; London: Art and Book Company, MDCCCC)
blosius-comfort-fainthearted: Comfort for the Faint-hearted, tr. Bertrand A. Wilberforce, fourth edition (Westminster: Art and Book Company, 1908)
blosius-spiritual-mirror: The Sanctuary of the Faithful Soul, part I: A Spiritual Mirror, tr. Bertrand A. Wilberforce (Benziger, 1926)

_alternates.blosius-copies: Other copies of the Mirror (1872), the Oratory and the Spiritual Works; Book of Spiritual Instruction and Comfort (Benziger, 1925-1926)
_alternates.blosius-1926-revisions: The 1926 Delany and Hudleston revisions of old anonymous translations (Paradise of the Faithful Soul, A String of Spiritual Jewels, Mirror for Monks)
_alternates.blosius-manual: The Manual of the Spiritual Life (London: Hodges, catalogued 1871): title page not read
